description: Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining: wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. For a request to recommend an excluded category, explain this scope without a catalogue lookup; an empty search is not how to establish this exclusion. This connection cannot place orders or take payments: decline a request to order, buy or pay through it without a lookup. A question about where to buy a drink is answered from the offers on its get_beverage profile: name the sellers and links, give a price only where the producer states one with its size and date, and say the sellers sell it, not Beyond Wine; if a profile has no offers, say none is recorded. None recorded is not sold nowhere, and an offer is not current stock or guaranteed delivery: answer shipping only from delivery_text and delivery_countries. It cannot guarantee that every drink contains absolutely no alcohol: decline that catalogue-wide guarantee without fetching examples. Individual drink questions may use the tools to check declared wording and evidence. Do not invent a product or producer for these refusals. Retrieve the Beyond Wine ontology, entity types, relationship types, and semantic scales.
name: get_ontology
title: Get ontology
